message.content:
The root cause of the repeated error is that I used an f-string with a newline inside it without properly escaping or formatting it, causing a syntax error. Specifically, `print(f'Assay batch distribution:\n{tab_batch}')` is invalid because the f-string is not closed before the newline.

I will fix this by using a normal string with `.format()` or by splitting the print into two lines.
